en: The postcard features a sepia-toned studio photograph of a young person dressed in traditional Southeast Asian attire. The subject holds a large parasol and a long pipe, and wears a floral hair ornament. The backdrop includes a variety of potted leafy plants and what appears to be a staged interior setting typical of early 20th-century photographic studios. The photograph is formal and posed, typical of portrait postcards from the colonial era.
